look_here_first: View flower SIDE-ON: corolla tube (20–)28–41(–45) mm, much longer than A. ciliata at 6–9(–10) mm. Measure the whole tube with a ruler. A frontal flower view cannot establish tube length.

morphology_keys.habit: Perennial herb with narrow-leaved stems and tubular flowers.
morphology_keys.leaves: Simple narrow stem leaves; examine attachment at node.
morphology_keys.flowers: Five corolla lobes above an exceptionally long narrow tube, (20–)28–41(–45) mm.
morphology_keys.fruit: Paired slender follicles; obtain a mature fruit view.

comparisons.key_distinctions: The long measured corolla tube separates A. longiflora from the short-tubed A. ciliata. Flower color alone is unreliable.
